fier
⌈
The interface
ara::crypto::cryp::CryptoProvider::ConvertToAlgId
shall convert the provided primitive name from its string representation according to
NamingConvention into a vendor specific
ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId
. The inter-
face shall return
kAlgIdUndefined
, if the provided primitive name is not supported.
⌋
